title: A simple racer focused on speedrun mechanics, meet TRACK91
author: Tischler285
selftext:
Hey everyone,

My main goal was just to recreate a childhood Flash game I used to love, but with a bit of extra fine-tuning. I'm a huge fan of speedruns myself, so while the game is simple on the surface, it's packed with subtle mechanics to help you optimize and improve your times with every run.

Your ship reaches its absolute maximum speed when you're going completely straight and throttling up (using W/S to adjust your speed by +/- 15). However, every time you steer left or right, you take a slight penalty and lose 5 speed. Balancing that clean straight-line speed with precise steering is key to shaving seconds off your record.

The main goal is to survive and beat Track 91, but the real challenge is finishing the game as fast as possible by mastering your throttling and steering lines.

It runs right in the browser with local high scores and customizable keybinds. Let me know what kind of times and average speeds you guys can pull off, that is if you can beat TRACK 91!

(Thinking about a reward for the first person to beat it with proof...)
